card.name: Right before the word other
card.fires_on: The word just before "other" or "-othermia", such as "the" in "the other way", "reasons" in "reasons other than", or "and" in "and other CNS depressants". It also fires inside words like hypothermia and chemotherapeutic.

modes.label: Idiom the other way
modes.description: "the" before "other way" in phrases like look the other way or ask the question the other way around.
modes.example: the few honest ones are forced to look<< the>> other way.

modes.label: Reasons/routes other than
modes.description: A noun or "and" directly followed by "other than" or "other" in label text.
modes.example: Safety for use by<< routes>> other than intravenous administration has not been

modes.label: Inside -thermia words
modes.description: Partway through hypothermia or normothermia, where "other" is the next piece.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "other" and its variants, so it lowers the chance that "other" comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before the word "other" is expected, as in "reasons other than" or "the other way".
